beats.text: I sometimes use two cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. With two different coats hanging beside them?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the reversed recruitment banner closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. You joined the cleanup; now here's what we're really cleaning out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not what I joined.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. It was the part you could join before seeing the whole problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the second invitation closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Our side isn't against them; it's against the plan we both signed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So we're undoing our own plan?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Together. That's why I needed you inside it first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the cancellation fee closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Pay the deposit first; then backing out becomes the difficult choice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We haven't even booked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Precisely why paying a small fee makes booking feel sensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the first consequence closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Accept this small cost and the big step will already be underway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why accept a cost before starting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Then the next step protects an investment instead of creating a risk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the first sketch closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Remember this tiny suggestion before claiming the final design.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That mark was an accident.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. And the accident belongs to my pencil. Credit its owner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the old pencil mark closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. That mark is what kept everything else from collapsing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We couldn't know it mattered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Now we do. Go back to the first line of your thank-you speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the old promise in writing closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Choose the trip, and that old promise becomes a goodbye.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday you told me to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Choose it now and we'll know whether yesterday was permission or surrender.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the reopened agreement closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Pick this now, and yesterday's refusal turns into permission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're changing what I meant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. I'm asking which meaning your next choice will leave behind.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the unsigned commitment closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Sign if you're serious; I haven't decided how serious I can afford to be.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why haven't you signed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. I needed to see whether you could trust me without matching evidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the protected stake closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Take that risk for me while I keep this one thing safe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You won't risk the same thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Then perhaps this test has discovered something about me instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the spare key closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Give me that spare key; then we can discuss why I can't use the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, take that one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. If one key is harmless, perhaps we can talk about the other door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the note with the concession underlined closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. If that exception is fair, the larger one follows the same rule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a tiny exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Exactly. We've established the principle without frightening anyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the old ribbon closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Remember this ribbon? Blame the whole arrangement, not who tied it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tied that knot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Yes, but remember how innocent the ribbon seemed at first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the opening cup closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Every problem started with that cup, not my hand beside it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hand knocked it over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Let's not let one hand distract us from that ominous opening cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the first question on the clipboard closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it was raining.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked about your mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. And before that you asked about the rain. I'm being thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the lunch form closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Before your question about my mistake, let me finish discussing lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've finished discussing lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. I hadn't mentioned the soup. An incomplete answer would be rude.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the folded pages closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. There was a small change; I'll explain how small once you're ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How small a change?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. The date is the smallest part. Let's finish tea before the venue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the gentler account closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. When I said postponed, I meant the original event won't return unchanged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What does unchanged mean?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. The invitation still has our names. That's the part we can hold onto first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the half admission closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. I changed the time; yours is the only missing piece of the story now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why tell me only half?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Because the second half is sitting in your envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the small confession closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. I hid the first letter. What happened to the second?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So you hid the letter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. The first. I'm offering that truth so you can place yours beside it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the failed result closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. That strange noise was the turning point, not a warning I missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ignored the strange noise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. I treated it as foreshadowing. Now its significance is wonderfully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the old sketch closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. The ending was foreshadowed here; the plan needed this reversal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plan collapsed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Exactly at the point this drawing becomes interesting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the vague prediction closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. When I said 'a change', I obviously meant this precise disaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. I said things would flow differently. Read with professional imagination.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the wrong forecast closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Read it metaphorically and you'll see I was right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says sunny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. An emotional forecast. The umbrellas represent personal growth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the renamed score column closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Fewest points means greatest self-control; I've won that category.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You came last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. In speed. First in refusing to rush the experience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the tiny trophy closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Size measures insecurity now, so this is the better prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the consolation prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. For whoever needs a large trophy. I'm delighted with my superior restraint.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the hopeful drawing closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. We wanted a place to belong; even this wreck can become that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The place is wrecked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. But we drew somewhere for us, not somewhere already perfect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the first promise on paper closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. We're still making that hope real, just in a larger shape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before everything failed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Then let's make the promise large enough to include the wreckage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the wrapped cup closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Take this for whenever you remember these afternoons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are you giving me this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. So you won't have to come back just to remember tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the straightened coat closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. You'll do beautifully wherever the next door opens.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That sounds like goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Only the sort that hopes your next doorway fits you better.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the two prices closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. The lift costs petrol and the conversation we've been avoiding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for petrol.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. And we'll talk during the drive. That's the part I couldn't put on the receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the bill and photograph closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Pay for the repair in money, and for the silence in honesty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why charge for silence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Because money repairs the chair. Honesty repairs why I broke it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the quoted agreement closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. I promised to carry a box, not whichever box you point at forever.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. With a box. That was before you gave the warehouse a name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the underlined today closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Yes, I said today; tomorrow wasn't included in those words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow is practically the same.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. Not to the sentence we both agreed to yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the cup, note, and key closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Every little choice has brought us to this locked door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How are those connected?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. The cup hid the note, the note asked for the key, and now neither of us can leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull the napkin with our returning joke closer.
beats.text: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. Remember saying nothing could go wrong? Look at what we're carrying now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was only a joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me the public version now. And now you're holding its three separate consequences. Which one do we solve first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's private information.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.
